semantic_meaning: I05 adds no raw-denominator adequacy floor beyond the exact typed support states already emitted by I03. This value does not state that denominator zero or one is statistically adequate; it states only that this production profile does not introduce a new count threshold.
what_it_does: satisfies the frozen engine requirement for an exact nonnegative integer support field
prevents invention of an ungoverned numeric adequacy threshold
allows validators to run after already-governed NONCOMPARABLE, UNAVAILABLE, and VALID_EMPTY handling when primary empirical facts remain
what_it_does_not_mean: does not convert LOW_SUPPORT to SUPPORTED
does not make I05 a structural-admission or causal-validity court
does not prune or change candidate reachability
low_support: LOW_SUPPORT remains an I03 empirical-fact state and remains visible in discovery support summaries; this rule does not add a count-floor override that relabels it UNDERPOWERED.
underpowered: EVALUATED_UNDERPOWERED is intentionally unreachable through this count-floor field under this rule. The vocabulary remains part of the frozen engine and may become reachable only under a separately authorized and newly versioned positive support rule or another exact operation-valid support authority.
valid_empty: All-zero-denominator or ZERO_SUPPORT/VALID_EMPTY candidate fact sets are classified by the existing terminal fact law before the minimum-denominator check; this rule does not change VALID_EMPTY.
observed_zero: OBSERVED_ZERO already requires positive raw denominator and zero numerator; this rule does not change it.
uncertainty: UNCERTAINTY_UNQUANTIFIED remains exactly unquantified. No estimator, confidence rule, effect threshold, or power claim is introduced.
validators: DISTRIBUTION_DIFFERS_FROM_BASELINE, JOINT_NOT_PRODUCT_OF_MARGINALS, CONDITIONAL_REVERSAL, and TARGET_CELL_SUPPORTED remain unchanged and execute only after existing terminal-state handling.
replay: The rule identity/hash and support_rules value enter the adopted DiscoveryAuthority semantic material, thereby changing the final DiscoveryAuthority/frontier/replay identities without changing the frozen candidate set.
no_data_basis: Chosen before production outcomes and justified by accepted noninference law: where no positive minimum-support authority exists, the least additional semantic commitment expressible by the current engine is an explicit zero floor, not an inferred positive floor.
versioning: Any future positive minimum_raw_denominator, uncertainty estimator, power rule, or altered interaction with LOW_SUPPORT/VALID_EMPTY/OBSERVED_ZERO requires a new rule version and new DiscoveryAuthority/frontier/replay identities.
